text:
marta: Quick heads-up — Acme HW is asking for a joint Marketplace + hardware bundle. They want a co-funded credit pool in the cloud marketplace plus a hardware rebate tied to committed usage. Can we sketch a working pricing approach and announcement window?

sam: Do we have rough % splits or $ targets from Acme? timeline for launch?

marta: They proposed three variants on call: starter, growth, enterprise. Rough sketch: 
```
Starter: 10% marketplace credit + $100 HW rebate per device
Growth: 20% marketplace credit + $250 HW rebate per device
Enterprise: 30% marketplace credit + custom HW rebate (negotiated)
```
They want a Q3 joint announcement but Acme is flexible if our legal/pricing needs extra time.

ida: OK but we need to translate "marketplace credit %" to actual SKU-level credits. Marketplace discounts eat margin — we should floor at 12% net to us after cloud fees & rebate. Also need an unused-credit expiry (suggest 6 months) and conversion rules if customers downgrade.

james: From the SI side: integration timeline is ~8 weeks for our deployment templates + runbook. Marketing wants a 2-week PR prep window. If legal needs >2 weeks we should slip announcement. Also: avoid announcing a hard commit threshold until our telemetry gating is ready.

ana-legal: quick note (from legal): include roll-forward clause for unused credits, cap on aggregate rebates per customer, and an opt-out for compliance issues. We'll need draft contract language; can we get the final numbers by EOW?

acme-rep: We're aligned on the 3-tier structure. Acme would prefer 9-12 month credit validity but ok with 6 months if it speeds launch. We can share device shipment cadence to better model rebate pacing.

ida: Two practical asks from pricing ops: (1) provide SKU mapping to marketplace SKU IDs so we can set credit attachment rules, (2) confirm whether credits are applied at purchase time or as monthly reimbursement.

marta: Proposal: credits apply at checkout (preferred), expire after 6 months, and unused credits roll into a one-time account credit on expiry (no cash payout). Can we gate the Enterprise tier to manual approval (legal + acct exec)?

sam: I'll own the announcement runbook. Volunteers for the launch checklist: pricing ops (ida) for SKU wiring, legal (ana-legal) for T&Cs, partner eng (james) for integration, partner PM (marta) as owner. Marketing will need assets by July 10th to hit a July 24th announcement.

ida: I'll draft the SKU wiring template and a sample credit policy by Wed.

ana-legal: I'll circulate contract language draft by Thu, include rollback & misuse clauses.

james: We'll target a canary region (EU-West) deployment first, then roll globally. Need a smoke-test checklist — I'll drop it here once ready.

acme-rep: FYI Acme can commit to a co-fund cap per quarter to limit exposure. We'll send an initial cap proposal.

marta: Nice. Next sync: 30m on Mon. Sam, can you create a calendar invite and include Acme PM?

sched-bot: Meeting created: "Acme market+HW bundle sync" — Mon 09:00 PT, 30m. Invite sent to participants. :calendar:
